title: I Asked ChatGPT What It Knows About Me
description:
What does ChatGPT actually remember about you?

In this video, I walk through 6 prompts you can use to better understand your saved memories, review what ChatGPT has inferred from past conversations, and manage your memory settings.

You'll learn how to:

Review your saved memories
Explore what ChatGPT may have inferred from your conversations
Identify recurring patterns in your interactions
Use prompts for self-reflection and planning
Manage and delete saved memories
Adjust your training and personalization settings

Understanding your memory settings helps you decide what information you want ChatGPT to retain and what you'd rather remove.
